thread:
Mia: trying the private quickstart (vpc install) and my first API call is failing with an SSL error. dashboard shows workspace active and billing ok, but curl returns TLS verify error. i used: ```curl --cert client.pem --key client.key -v https://private.redwood.example/v1/chat``` getting 'verify return:1' and 'certificate verify failed'. any pointers? :confused:

Sam: can you paste the full curl -v output (redacting tokens)? most tls cert issues here are cert chain ordering or missing intermediate CA. also which quickstart did you follow?

Mia: pasted output (redacted): ```* Connected to private.redwood.example (10.0.0.5) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Encrypted Extensions (8)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Certificate (11)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED
* SSL: certificate verify failed
* Closing connection 0
curl: (60) SSL: certificate verify failed```

Taylor: yep almost always a cert chain problem. the server sent only the leaf cert, or your client cert is missing the intermediate chain. try `openssl s_client -connect private.redwood.example:443 -showcerts -CAfile ca.pem` to see how the chain is presented. if you're presenting a client cert to the server (mTLS), make sure client.pem contains both client cert and intermediate(s) in the right order: leaf first, then intermediate(s).

Mia: ran openssl and saw only leaf from my client bundle. i did `cat client.crt intermediate.pem > client.pem` and retried. after that the curl -v shows full handshake and the API returned 200. so root cause was missing intermediate in client cert bundle.

Mia: one oddity — when this failed earlier the console showed a small billing notice (payment method missing) and i assumed billing blocked the first call. that was misleading. can we show TLS errors in the quickstart logs instead of a generic billing hint? :thinking:

devex-bot: Created DX ticket DX-1245: "Quickstart: surface TLS/mTLS errors during first-call flow; avoid conflating with billing toast". Runbook: https://internal.docs/redwood/devex/quickstart-tls-checks

Lucas: i'll take a docs PR to add an mTLS checklist and sample script to combine cert+intermediate and an openssl verify step. i can add the exact curl and s_client examples.

eng-runtime-oncall: thanks @Mia — can you attach the failing server side logs (redact IPs) to DX-1245? i want to confirm server didn't drop the client cert earlier. also which private deploy image/version?

Mia: will attach logs to the ticket and include the quickstart link i used. private deploy image is rwd-infer/1.8.3. resolved for now, thanks everyone, opening PR for docs in a bit. :tada:
